senses.sense_definition: A brief evocative description, account, or short scene.

examples.text: The author began each chapter with a delightful <w>vignette</w> describing rural life.
Her memoir contains a vivid <w>vignette</w> depicting childhood summers by the sea.

senses.sense_definition: A photograph or picture whose edges shade off gradually into the background.

examples.text: The photographer applied a soft <w>vignette</w> to draw attention to the subject's face.
Old family portraits often had a subtle <w>vignette</w> fading into a cream background.

senses.sense_definition: A small sticker affixed to a vehicle's windshield showing that a road toll or tax has been paid.

examples.text: Drivers must purchase a <w>vignette</w> before traveling on the highway.
Ensure that the annual <w>vignette</w> is clearly visible on the front windshield.

senses.sense_definition: A small decorative design or illustration used on a title page or at the beginning or end of a chapter.

examples.text: An intricate floral <w>vignette</w> was printed at the top of the introductory page.
The antique book featured a delicate woodcut <w>vignette</w> concluding every chapter.

senses.sense_definition: The central pictorial design of a postage stamp, banknote, or stock certificate.

examples.text: The <w>vignette</w> on the newly issued stamp portrays a historic lighthouse.
Collectors closely examined the engraved <w>vignette</w> for any printing flaws.

senses.sense_definition: A running architectural ornament of leaves and tendrils, characteristic of Gothic design.

examples.text: The stone arch was carved with an elaborate <w>vignette</w> of trailing ivy.
A stone <w>vignette</w> ran along the molding beneath the cathedral roof.

senses.sense_definition: A reduction in an image's brightness or saturation at the periphery compared to the image center.

examples.text: Using a cheap lens adapter caused a heavy <w>vignette</w> in the corners of every frame.
The optical defect produced an unwanted <w>vignette</w> across the edges of the image.

senses.sense_definition: A display defect where screen brightness or color degrades toward the edges, particularly at an angle.

examples.text: The cheaper monitor suffered from a visible <w>vignette</w> along the outer borders.
Users noticed a slight yellow <w>vignette</w> whenever looking at the display from the side.

senses.sense_definition: To produce an image, photograph, or illustration with edges that gradually fade away.

examples.text: The graphic designer decided to <w>vignette</w> the background to highlight the main subject.
She <w>vignetted</w> the portrait so that it blended smoothly into the blank page.
